}</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Inner space at the left.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>padding-left</code></li><li>B. <code>align-self</code></li><li>C. <code>widows</code></li><li>D. <code>field-sizing</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7101">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7102 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7103">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7103" data-page="7103" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6226"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7103 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6226 — aside × background-attachment</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">aside</span> <span class="badge prop">background-attachment</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-attachment</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;aside&gt;</code> — content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote). What to show when text overflows a clipped box (ellipsis!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;canvas&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><canvas width="200" height="80" style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:6px;background:#fff"></canvas><script>document.querySelector("canvas").getContext("2d").fillStyle="#4285f4",document.querySelector("canvas").getContext("2d").fillRect(10,10,80,40)</script></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;canvas id=&quot;c&quot; x.fillStyle = &quot;#34a853&quot;; x.fillRect(100, 20, 80, 40); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-overflow</b> = <b>clip</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>canvas { text-overflow: clip; Justification method (CJK mostly).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;rp&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;font-family:serif;color:#6b7280">木(mù) — what old browsers would see</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;木&lt;rp&gt;(&lt;/rp&gt;&lt;rt&gt;mù&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;rp&gt;)&lt;/rp&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-justify</b> = <b>inter-character</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>rp { text-justify: inter-character; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches elements that HAVE the attribute.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>B. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7163">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7164 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7165">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7165" data-page="7165" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6288"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7165 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6288 — dt × background-size</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dt</span> <span class="badge prop">background-size</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-size</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dt&gt;</code> — the term (name) in a description list. How big the background image renders.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dt&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:700">term <span style="font-weight:400;color:#6b7280">(dt)</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;term&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;definition&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-size</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dt { background-size: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value ends with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>C. <code>:checked</code></li><li>D. <code>descendant (space)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7164">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7165 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7166">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7166" data-page="7166" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6289"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7166 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6289 — track × mix-blend-mode</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">track</span> <span class="badge prop">mix-blend-mode</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">mix-blend-mode</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;track&gt;</code> — captions, subtitles or chapters for &lt;video&gt;/&lt;audio&gt;. How the element&#x27;s pixels blend with what&#x27;s behind it.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;track&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#000;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;text-align:center">“Welcome to the course”</div><div style="text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:#6b7280">CC · English (default) · Chapters</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;movie.mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; src=&quot;en.vtt&quot; srclang=&quot;en&quot; label=&quot;English&quot; default&gt; &lt;/video&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>mix-blend-mode</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>track { mix-blend-mode: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is under the pointer.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:empty</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7165">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7166 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7167">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7167" data-page="7167" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6290"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7167 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6290 — param × content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">param</span> <span class="badge prop">content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;param&gt;</code> — a named parameter passed to an &lt;object&gt; resource. Insert generated text/images into ::before/::after (or replace content in replaced elements).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;param&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#f6f8fa;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">name="quality" value="high" → passed to the object</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;object data=&quot;game.swf&quot; type=&quot;application/x-shockwave-flash&quot;&gt; &lt;param name=&quot;quality&quot; value=&quot;high&quot;&gt; &lt;/object&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>content</b> = <b>string</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>param { content: string; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is being pressed/clicked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>B. <code>:target</code></li><li>C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:active</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7166">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7167 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7168">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7168" data-page="7168" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6291"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7168 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6291 — option × scroll-snap-stop</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">option</span> <span class="badge prop">scroll-snap-stop</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scroll-snap-stop</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;option&gt;</code> — a single choice inside &lt;select&gt; or &lt;datalist&gt;. Whether the scroller must stop at every snap point (normal) or can skip (always).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;option&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px"><div style="padding:4px 8px;background:#eff6ff;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0">✔ Alpha</div><div style="padding:4px 8px;color:#9ca3af">Beta (soon) — disabled</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;select&gt; &lt;option value=&quot;a&quot; selected&gt;Alpha&lt;/option&gt; &lt;option value=&quot;b&quot; disabled&gt;Beta (soon)&lt;/option&gt; &lt;/select&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-snap-stop</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>option { scroll-snap-stop: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? Shorthand: name + duration + timing + delay + iteration + direction + fill-mode + play-state.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;output&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:monospace;background:#f0fdf4;border:1px solid #86efac;border-radius:6px;padding:8px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><span>3</span>×<span>4</span>=<b style="background:#dcfce7;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px">12</b></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; id=&quot;a&quot; value=&quot;3&quot; aria-label=&quot;A&quot;&gt; × &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; id=&quot;b&quot; value=&quot;4&quot; aria-label=&quot;B&quot;&gt; = &lt;output name=&quot;result&quot; for=&quot;a b&quot;&gt;12&lt;/output&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>output { animation: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “First of its tag among siblings.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>~</code></li><li>D. <code>::cue</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7168">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7169 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7170">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7170" data-page="7170" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6293"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7170 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6293 — tfoot × transform-origin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">tfoot</span> <span class="badge prop">transform-origin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform-origin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;tfoot&gt;</code> — groups the footer (summary) rows of a table. The point transforms rotate/scale around.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;tfoot&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;border-top:2px solid #374151;display:flex"><div style="padding:4px 10px;font-weight:700">Total</div><div style="padding:4px 10px">$26,500</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;tfoot&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Total&lt;/th&gt;&lt;td&gt;$26,500&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/tfoot&gt; &lt;tbody&gt;…&lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transform-origin</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>tfoot { transform-origin: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Everything EXCEPT the selector inside.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:lang(code)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>.class</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7169">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7170 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7171">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7171" data-page="7171" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6294"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7171 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6294 — big × max-width</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">big</span> <span class="badge prop">max-width</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">max-width</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;big&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: big (obsolete). The upper limit of the width.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;big&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:15px">Bigger text — via CSS font-size</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;big&gt;Bigger text&lt;/big&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>max-width</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>big { max-width: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Parent selector! Matches if it CONTAINS the selector.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>B. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>C. <code>::placeholder</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr=value]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7170">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7171 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7172">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7172" data-page="7172" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6295"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7172 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6295 — noframes × padding-top</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">noframes</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-top</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-top</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;noframes&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: no frames fallback (obsolete). Inner space at the top (inside the border).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;noframes&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">Frames are gone — so is <noframes>.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;noframes&gt;Your browser doesn&#x27;t support frames.&lt;/noframes&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-top</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>noframes { padding-top: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Field required or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::before</code></li><li>B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7171">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7172 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7173">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7173" data-page="7173" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6296"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7173 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6296 — slot × border-collapse</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">slot</span> <span class="badge prop">border-collapse</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-collapse</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;slot&gt;</code> — a placeholder in a shadow dom template where light-dom content is projected. Merges adjacent table borders into one.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;slot&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="color:#0d9488;font-size:13px">Hello shadow <i>(projected into the slot)</i></span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;template shadowrootmode=&quot;open&quot;&gt; &lt;style&gt;span { color: teal; }&lt;/style&gt; &lt;span&gt;&lt;slot&gt;&lt;/slot&gt;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/template&gt; &lt;my-comp&gt;Hello shadow&lt;/my-comp&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-collapse</b> = <b>separate</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>slot { border-collapse: separate; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Number input within / outside min-max.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>D. <code>:focus</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7172">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7173 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7174">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7174" data-page="7174" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6297"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7174 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6297 — base × z-index</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">base</span> <span class="badge prop">z-index</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">z-index</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;base&gt;</code> — sets the base url for all relative urls on the page. Stacking order of positioned elements (higher = on top).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;base&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">base URL = https://docs.example.com/ → &lt;img src="a.png"&gt; loads docs.example.com/a.png</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;base href=&quot;https://docs.example.com/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>z-index</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>base { z-index: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Element&#x27;s text direction matches.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>B. <code>::marker</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>D. <code>:first-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7173">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7174 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7175">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7175" data-page="7175" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6298"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7175 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6298 — body × flex-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">body</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;body&gt;</code> — contains all the visible content of the html document. Whether flex items wrap to multiple lines.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;body&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#fff"><h1 style="margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px">Hello</h1><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Everything visible lives inside <b>&lt;body&gt;</b></p></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;body&gt; &lt;h1&gt;Hello&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;p&gt;World&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/body&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-wrap</b> = <b>nowrap</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>body { flex-wrap: nowrap; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The NEXT sibling, immediately after.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::cue</code></li><li>B. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7174">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7175 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7176">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7176" data-page="7176" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6299"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7176 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6299 — footer × order</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">footer</span> <span class="badge prop">order</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">order</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;footer&gt;</code> — footer content for a page or section: copyright, contact, related links. Changes the visual order of an item (without touching HTML).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;footer&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#111827;color:#9ca3af;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;text-align:center">© 2026 Mega Book Inc. — <i>footer</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;footer&gt; &lt;p&gt;© 2026 Mega Book Inc.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/footer&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>order</b> = <b>integer</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>footer { order: integer; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Generated content INSIDE the end of the element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>.class</code></li><li>B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::after</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7175">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7176 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7177">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7177" data-page="7177" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6300"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7177 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6300 — h3 × place-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h3</span> <span class="badge prop">place-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h3&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 3 (h1 = highest). Use the font&#x27;s optical sizes (automatically pick the right cut).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;wbr&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:110px;font-size:12px;word-break:break-word">https://example<wbr>.com/very/wbr/allows/line-breaks/here</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;a href=&quot;https://example.com/very/long/path&quot;&gt;https://example&lt;wbr&gt;.com/very/long/path&lt;/a&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-optical-sizing</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>wbr { font-optical-sizing: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The dim layer behind an open &lt;dialog&gt;.showModal().”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>[attr*=…]</code></li><li>B. <code>:only-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:checked</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::backdrop</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7177">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7178 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7179">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7179" data-page="7179" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6302"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7179 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6302 — b × text-shadow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">b</span> <span class="badge prop">text-shadow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-shadow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;b&gt;</code> — highlights text for utilitarian reasons without extra importance. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of overflow-wrap?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>normal</code></li><li>B. <code>banana2</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>break-word</code></li><li>D. <code>auto9</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7182">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7183 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7184">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7184" data-page="7184" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6307"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7184 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6307 — audio × user-drag</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">audio</span> <span class="badge prop">user-drag</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">user-drag</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;audio&gt;</code> — embeds an audio player (music, podcasts, sound effects). Whether the element can be dragged (legacy, mostly images).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;audio&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:220px;background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px"><span style="width:0;height:0;border-left:14px solid #2563eb;border-top:9px solid transparent;border-bottom:9px solid transparent"></span><div style="flex:1"><div style="height:5px;background:#e5e7eb;border-radius:3px"><div style="width:40%;height:100%;background:#2563eb;border-radius:3px"></div></div><small style="color:#6b7280">03:12 / 07:45 — podcast.mp3</small></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;audio controls src=&quot;podcast.mp3&quot;&gt;&lt;/audio&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>user-drag</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>audio { user-drag: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of hyphens?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>none</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>manual</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7191">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7192 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7193">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7193" data-page="7193" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6316"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7193 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6316 — template × font-weight</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">template</span> <span class="badge prop">font-weight</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-weight</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;template&gt;</code> — an inert container of markup that can be cloned by javascript. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Content rendered only when scripting is disabled or unsupported.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;mark&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;noscript&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;main&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7213">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7214 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7215">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7215" data-page="7215" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6338"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7215 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6338 — dialog × appearance</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dialog</span> <span class="badge prop">appearance</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">appearance</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dialog&gt;</code> — a native dialog box: modal when shown with showmodal(), non-modal when shown with show(). Reset or request the native form-control look.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dialog&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:240px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:14px;font-size:13px"><b>Are you sure?</b><div style="margin-top:10px;text-align:right"><button style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f9fafb;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;margin-right:6px;font-size:12px">Cancel</button><button style="border:none;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px">OK</button></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dialog id=&quot;dlg&quot;&gt; &lt;form method=&quot;dialog&quot;&gt; &lt;p&gt;Are you sure?&lt;/p&gt; &lt;button value=&quot;cancel&quot;&gt;Cancel&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button formnovalidate&gt;OK&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt; &lt;/dialog&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>appearance</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dialog { appearance: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A neutral block-level container with no semantic meaning.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;legend&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;figcaption&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;div&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7214">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7215 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7216">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7216" data-page="7216" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6339"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7216 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6339 — s × animation-iteration-count</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-iteration-count</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-iteration-count</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). How many times it loops (infinite = forever).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;s&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Price: <s style="color:#9ca3af">$99</s> <b>$79</b></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Price: &lt;s&gt;$99&lt;/s&gt; $79&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-iteration-count</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>s { animation-iteration-count: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;aside&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;time&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;caption&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h3&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7215">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7216 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7217">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7217" data-page="7217" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6340"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7217 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6340 — dfn × perspective-origin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dfn</span> <span class="badge prop">perspective-origin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">perspective-origin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dfn&gt;</code> — the term being defined on the page. Where the vanishing point sits (x y).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dfn&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px"><dfn style="font-style:italic"><b>semantics</b></dfn>: the meaning carried by markup, not just its appearance.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;&lt;dfn&gt;semantics&lt;/dfn&gt;: the meaning of markup.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>perspective-origin</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dfn { perspective-origin: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Footer content for a page or section: copyright, contact, related links.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;code&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;thead&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;h6&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;footer&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7216">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7217 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7218">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7218" data-page="7218" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6341"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7218 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6341 — sup × margin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sup</span> <span class="badge prop">margin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sup&gt;</code> — superscript text (rendered above the baseline). Logical top+bottom padding.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ol&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol start="2" style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Second step</li><li>Third step</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol start=&quot;2&quot;&gt; &lt;li&gt;Second step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Third step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-block</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ol { padding-block: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 2 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;rp&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;font&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;h2&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;blockquote&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7218">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7219 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7220">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7220" data-page="7220" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6343"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7220 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6343 — source × float</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">source</span> <span class="badge prop">float</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">float</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;source&gt;</code> — a candidate resource for &lt;video&gt;, &lt;audio&gt; or &lt;picture&gt;. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A thematic break between paragraphs (scene change, topic shift).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;hr&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;dl&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tt&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;strong&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7220">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7221 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7222">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7222" data-page="7222" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6345"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7222 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6345 — input × align-self</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">input</span> <span class="badge prop">align-self</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-self</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;input&gt;</code> — the most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more. &lt;label&gt;Full name &lt;input type=&quot;text&quot; name=&quot;name&quot; required autocomplete=&quot;name&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Email &lt;input type=&quot;email&quot; name=&quot;email&quot; required&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Age &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; name=&quot;age&quot; min=&quot;0&quot; max=&quot;120&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; name=&quot;news&quot; checked&gt; Newsletter&lt;/label&gt; &lt;button&gt;Send&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>align-self</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>input { align-self: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Preformatted text where whitespace and line breaks matter (code, diagrams).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;pre&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;img&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;frameset&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;u&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7221">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7222 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7223">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7223" data-page="7223" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6346"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7223 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6346 — label × grid-row</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">label</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-row</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-row</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;label&gt;</code> — a caption for a form control — clickable, and read by screen readers. (for styling). The size of the text.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;col&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;font-size:10px;height:26px"><div style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db">1</div><div style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#eef2ff">2</div><div style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#eef2ff">3</div><div style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#eef2ff">4</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;colgroup&gt;&lt;col span=&quot;1&quot;&gt;&lt;col span=&quot;3&quot; style=&quot;background:#eef2ff&quot;&gt;&lt;/colgroup&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-size</b> = <b>em</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>col { font-size: em; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Highlights text for utilitarian reasons without extra importance.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;dir&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;b&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7223">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7224 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7225">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7225" data-page="7225" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6348"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7225 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6348 — font × text-align</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">font</span> <span class="badge prop">text-align</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-align</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;font&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: font (obsolete). Horizontal alignment of inline content in a block.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;font&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-family:serif;color:#ef4444;font-size:13px">Legacy: <font> is dead — use CSS</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;font face=&quot;Arial&quot; color=&quot;red&quot;&gt;text&lt;/font&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-align</b> = <b>justify</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>font { text-align: justify; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Marks stress emphasis — change in meaning if removed.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;iframe&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;a&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;time&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;em&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7224">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7225 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7226">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7226" data-page="7226" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6349"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7226 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6349 — acronym × word-break</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">acronym</span> <span class="badge prop">word-break</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">word-break</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;acronym&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: acronym (obsolete). Where long words may break.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;acronym&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:13px"><abbr title="World Wide Web" style="text-decoration:underline dotted;cursor:help">WWW</abbr> — use <abbr> now</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;acronym title=&quot;World Wide Web&quot;&gt;WWW&lt;/acronym&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>word-break</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>acronym { word-break: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Side comments and small print: fine print, copyrights, legal notes.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;param&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;html&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;code&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;small&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7225">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7226 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7227">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7227" data-page="7227" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6350"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7227 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6350 — nextid × background-image</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">nextid</span> <span class="badge prop">background-image</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-image</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;nextid&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: nextid (obsolete). → "hi"</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;script src=&quot;app.js&quot; defer&gt;&lt;/script&gt; &lt;script&gt; console.log(&quot;hi&quot;); &lt;/script&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>counter-reset</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>script { counter-reset: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Sample output from a program or computer.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;datalist&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;samp&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;template&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;ul&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7228">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7229 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7230">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7230" data-page="7230" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6353"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7230 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6353 — aside × scroll-snap-type</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">aside</span> <span class="badge prop">scroll-snap-type</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scroll-snap-type</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;aside&gt;</code> — content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote). &lt;h3&gt;Did you know?&lt;/h3&gt; &lt;p&gt;HTML5 added 40+ new elements.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/aside&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-snap-type</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>aside { scroll-snap-type: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Subscript text (rendered below the baseline).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;sub&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;fieldset&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;section&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;dl&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7229">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7230 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7231">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7231" data-page="7231" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6354"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7231 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6354 — figcaption × transition-timing-function</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">figcaption</span> <span class="badge prop">transition-timing-function</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition-timing-function</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;figcaption&gt;</code> — the caption for a &lt;figure&gt;. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The annotation text inside &lt;ruby&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;table&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;rt&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;nav&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;img&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7230">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7231 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7232">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7232" data-page="7232" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6355"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7232 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6355 — p × animation-range</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">p</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-range</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-range</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;p&gt;</code> — a block of text — the basic unit of written content. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Legacy/obsolete element: Single Index Prompt (obsolete).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;hr&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;isindex&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;title&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7250">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7251 / 8000 · Practice 32</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7252">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7252" data-page="7252" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6375"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 32</span><span>Page 7252 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6375 — em × overflow-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">em</span> <span class="badge prop">overflow-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">overflow-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;em&gt;</code> — marks stress emphasis — change in meaning if removed. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Move the element along an SVG path (motion path).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>offset-path</code></li><li>B. <code>top</code></li><li>C. <code>font-kerning</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7319">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7320 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7321">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7321" data-page="7321" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6444"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7321 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6444 — header × color-scheme</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">header</span> <span class="badge prop">color-scheme</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">color-scheme</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;header&gt;</code> — introductory content or a set of navigational links for a section or page. Declare light/dark support (form controls, scrollbars, canvas default bg).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;header&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4285f4,#34a853);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#fff"><b style="font-size:15px">My Blog</b><div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.85;margin-top:2px">header — intro content for the page</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;header&gt; &lt;h1&gt;My Blog&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;nav&gt;...&lt;/nav&gt; &lt;/header&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>color-scheme</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>header { color-scheme: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches every element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:focus</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>*</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7320">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7321 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7322">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7322" data-page="7322" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6445"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7322 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6445 — h2 × list-style-type</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h2</span> <span class="badge prop">list-style-type</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">list-style-type</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h2&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 2 (h1 = highest). The bullet/number marker style.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h2&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:21.0px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 2</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h2&gt;Heading level 2&lt;/h2&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>list-style-type</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h2 { list-style-type: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by unique id.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>#id</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>:target</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7321">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7322 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7323">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7323" data-page="7323" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6446"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7323 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6446 — br × scroll-behavior</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">br</span> <span class="badge prop">scroll-behavior</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scroll-behavior</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;br&gt;</code> — a single line break (forced newline) in the text. Smooth or instant scrolling for the element (and anchor jumps).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;br&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;background:#fafbfc;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:8px;border-radius:6px">12 Main St.<br>Cairo, Egypt<br>12611</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;address&gt;12 Main St.&lt;br&gt;Cairo, Egypt&lt;br&gt;12611&lt;/address&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scroll-behavior</b> = <b>smooth</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>br { scroll-behavior: smooth; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value starts with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>B. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>C. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7322">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7323 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7324">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7324" data-page="7324" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6447"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7324 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6447 — span × transition</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">span</span> <span class="badge prop">transition</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transition</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;span&gt;</code> — a neutral inline container with no meaning. Shorthand: property + duration + timing-function + delay.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;span&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Total: <span style="color:#16a34a;font-weight:700">$49</span> <span style="color:#9ca3af;text-decoration:line-through;font-size:11px">$60</span></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Total: &lt;span class=&quot;price&quot;&gt;$49&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transition</b> = <b>all .3s ease</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>span { transition: all .3s ease; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches an element in a state.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>B. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:</code></li><li>D. <code>~</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7323">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7324 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7325">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7325" data-page="7325" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6448"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7325 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6448 — small × animation-play-state</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">small</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-play-state</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-play-state</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;small&gt;</code> — side comments and small print: fine print, copyrights, legal notes. Pause or resume a running animation.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;small&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Offer ends Friday. <small style="font-size:11px;color:#6b7280">T&amp;Cs apply.</small></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Offer ends Friday. &lt;small&gt;T&amp;Cs apply.&lt;/small&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-play-state</b> = <b>paused</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>small { animation-play-state: paused; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Focus via keyboard (not mouse click).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>B. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>D. <code>::first-letter</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7324">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7325 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7326">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7326" data-page="7326" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6449"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7326 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6449 — time × offset-rotate</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">time</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-rotate</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-rotate</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;time&gt;</code> — a machine-readable date, time, or duration (calendar integration). Rotation of the element relative to the path (auto follows the tangent).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;time&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Published <time datetime="2026-09-16" style="color:#1a56db;font-weight:600">16 September 2026</time></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;time datetime=&quot;2026-09-16&quot;&gt;16 September 2026&lt;/time&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>offset-rotate</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>time { offset-rotate: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:checked</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>D. <code>::placeholder</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7325">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7326 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7327">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7327" data-page="7327" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6450"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7327 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6450 — ruby × margin-bottom</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ruby</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-bottom</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-bottom</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ruby&gt;</code> — japanese/chinese pinyin-style pronunciation annotation. Distance below the element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ruby&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:serif"><ruby>中<rt style="font-size:9px">zhōng</rt></ruby>国<rp>(</rp><rt style="font-size:9px">guó</rt><rp>)</rp></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;中&lt;rt&gt;zhōng&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;&lt;ruby&gt;国&lt;rt&gt;guó&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-bottom</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ruby { margin-bottom: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child OF ITS TAG type (ignores other tags).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7326">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7327 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7328">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7328" data-page="7328" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6451"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7328 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6451 — li × border-style</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">li</span> <span class="badge prop">border-style</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-style</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;li&gt;</code> — a single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;. The line style of the border (all sides, 1–4 values).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;li&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Start</li><li value="10">Jumps to 10</li><li>Then 11</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol&gt; &lt;li&gt;Start&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li value=&quot;10&quot;&gt;Jumps to 10&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Then 11&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-style</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>li { border-style: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “No children at all (not even text).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::after</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:empty</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7327">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7328 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7329">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7329" data-page="7329" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6452"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7329 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6452 — video × top</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">video</span> <span class="badge prop">top</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">top</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;video&gt;</code> — embeds a video player with optional controls, autoplay, loop and captions. Vertical offset for positioned elements.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;video&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:230px;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a5f,#0f172a);border-radius:8px;position:relative"><span style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center"><span style="width:0;height:0;border-left:22px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-top:14px solid transparent;border-bottom:14px solid transparent"></span></span><span style="position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:8px;font-size:10px;color:#e5e7eb">▶ clip.mp4 — controls</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls width=&quot;320&quot; poster=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.webm&quot; type=&quot;video/webm&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.mp4&quot; type=&quot;video/mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; src=&quot;en.vtt&quot; srclang=&quot;en&quot; label=&quot;EN&quot;&gt; &lt;/video&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>top</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>video { top: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Like :is but with ZERO specificity.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7328">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7329 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7330">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7330" data-page="7330" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6453"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7330 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6453 — embed × contain</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">embed</span> <span class="badge prop">contain</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">contain</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;embed&gt;</code> — embeds an external application (legacy plugin interface). Limits an element&#x27;s side effects (layout, paint, size, style) to its subtree.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;embed&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;width:220px;padding:10px;background:#f9fafb;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace">document.pdf<br><span style="color:#6b7280">application/pdf — 100% × 400</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;embed src=&quot;document.pdf&quot; type=&quot;application/pdf&quot; width=&quot;100%&quot; height=&quot;400&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>contain</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>embed { contain: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Form control usable or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>~</code></li><li>C. <code>::backdrop</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p7329">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 7330 / 8000 · Practice 33</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p7331">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p7331" data-page="7331" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 6454"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 33</span><span>Page 7331 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 6454 — button × flex-basis</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">button</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-basis</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-basis</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;button&gt;</code> — a clickable button: submit, reset, or script-triggered action. The item&#x27;s starting main-size before grow/shrink.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;button&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button style="background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 16px;font-size:12px">Search (submit)</button><button style="background:#f3f4f6;color:#374151;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px">Clear (button)</button></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;q&quot; required&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot;&gt;Search&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; id=&quot;clear&quot;&gt;Clear&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-basis</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>button { flex-basis: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do?
